column1: # Mixage — Reloop "Mixage Interface Edition MK2 Instruction Manual" 7.2 MIDI Assignment Chart
# The original Mixage manual was not found on reloop.com; this is the Interface Edition MK2 chart.
# MIDI channel 1 (the default). SW/CENTER/LED/LEVEL = 0x9n, VR/ENC = 0xBn (as the chart notes say).
# CUE1-4 are the Sync/CUP/Cue/Play buttons (manual T16-T19), so they carry no expect.
